product_name: Blazer Pendek Profesional Versi Korea Slim-Fit Wanita
opening_line: Korang yang selalu rasa tenggelam bila pakai blazer kerja labuh, stop dulu! Blazer pendek potongan Korea ni penyelamat terbaik, sarung je automatik nampak tinggi dan kaki terus nampak panjang!
closing_line: Padankan dengan seluar palazo potongan lurus macam saya, memang terus naik seri gaya profesional. Nak tampil yakin bergaya ke pejabat, cepat tekan beg kuning sebelum kehabisan saiz korang!

scenes.scene_1_intro:
Static locked-off vertical shot, the camera does not move. A young Malaysian Muslimah wearing a neat nude-taupe bawal chiffon hijab, an elegant Korean-style slim-fit short professional blazer in oat-grey over a tucked-in cream ribbed inner top, high-waisted khaki tailored wide-leg trousers, and cream pointed flats stands in a bright sunlit executive lounge with large arched windows, sheer white curtains, textured cream limewash walls, and a potted monstera plant in soft focus. Both hands remain empty and relaxed low at her sides. She smiles warmly and confidently at the camera, then gently pivots her body forty-five degrees to her right to reveal the blazer's flattering waist-level cut and clean structured shoulder drape, speaking continuously with realistic lip-sync. Clear Malaysian Malay female voice. No background music, only her voice and soft ambient sound.

Spoken Malay (Lip-sync): "Korang yang selalu rasa tenggelam bila pakai blazer kerja labuh, stop dulu! Blazer pendek potongan Korea ni penyelamat terbaik, sarung je automatik nampak tinggi dan kaki terus nampak panjang!"
scenes.scene_2_detail:
Static locked-off vertical shot, the camera does not move. The same young Malaysian Muslimah in the nude-taupe hijab, oat-grey short blazer, khaki trousers, and cream flats begins in a side profile view, hands resting completely empty at her sides, in the identical sunlit executive lounge. She smoothly turns further away into an elegant over-the-shoulder angle, glancing back toward the viewer with a friendly smile while showcasing the seamless back silhouette and neat waistline cut, speaking continuously with realistic lip-sync. Clear Malaysian Malay female voice. No background music, only her voice and soft ambient sound.

Spoken Malay (Lip-sync): "Bila pusing ke sisi, potongan pinggang dia memang terletak kemas dan tak menggelebeh langsung. Bahu dia ada struktur lembut yang bagi ilusi postur tegap dan kemas sepanjang hari."

caption: Korang yang selalu rasa tenggelam bila pakai blazer kerja labuh, stop dulu! Blazer pendek potongan Korea ni penyelamat terbaik untuk tampil kemas dan berkarisma. Potongan cropped slim-fit ni automatik bagi efek ilusi badan lebih tinggi dan kaki nampak lebih panjang. Bahu berstruktur kemas dengan fabrik selesa tak tebal yang sangat sesuai untuk cuaca Malaysia. Padankan dengan seluar palazo atau slack potongan lurus dan tudung bawal macam saya, memang terus naik aura wanita korporat moden! Cepat tekan beg kuning sekarang untuk survey saiz korang sebelum stok habis licin! 👇✨
